DataTableProps.name: idAccessor
DataTableProps.description: Row ID for selection and expansion: a unique, stable string or finite number. Default: `row.id`.

DataTableProps.name: mode
DataTableProps.description:
`'client'`: the table filters, searches, sorts and pages `rows`.
`'server'`: `rows` is the current result; fetch it in `onChange`. Default: `'client'`.

DataTableProps.name: pagination
DataTableProps.description: Enable pagination. `true` uses client defaults.

DataTableProps.name: onChange
DataTableProps.description:
Called with the complete table request. Global search typing is debounced; other changes
are immediate. In server mode it is also called once on mount with the initial request.

DataTableProps.name: globalSearch
DataTableProps.description: Show the global search in the toolbar.

DataTableProps.name: columnSelector
DataTableProps.description: Show the column selector in the toolbar.

DataTableProps.name: showTableStatePills
DataTableProps.description: Show applied sort, filters, searches and hidden columns as removable pills.

DataTableProps.name: maxChips
DataTableProps.description: Pills shown before the rest move into a "+N more" popover. Default: 5.

DataTableProps.name: showReset
DataTableProps.description: Show the reset button in the toolbar.

DataTableProps.name: debounceTime
DataTableProps.description: Global search typing delay in milliseconds. Default: 300.

DataTableProps.name: onRowClick
DataTableProps.type: (row: T, index: number, event: MouseEvent<HTMLTableRowElement>) => void

DataTableProps.name: loading
DataTableProps.description: Show an overlay over the current rows while the caller loads data.

DataTableProps.name: error
DataTableProps.description: Error from the caller. The current rows stay visible.

DataTableProps.name: emptyState
DataTableProps.description: Content shown when there are no rows.

DataTableProps.name: persistKey
DataTableProps.description: Persist hidden and pinned columns in localStorage under this key.

DataTableProps.name: minWidth
DataTableProps.description: Table width at which it scrolls horizontally.

DataTableProps.name: maxHeight
DataTableProps.description: Height at which the table scrolls vertically.

DataTableProps.name: labels
DataTableProps.description: Replace built-in UI text.

DataTableProps.name: dateInput
DataTableProps.description: Date input for date filters, e.g. `DatePickerInput` from `@mantine/dates`. Default: a native date input.

DataTableProps.name: borderColor
DataTableProps.description: Color of table borders, key of `theme.colors` or any valid CSS color

DataTableProps.name: withTableBorder
DataTableProps.description: If set, the table has the outer border

DataTableProps.name: withColumnBorders
DataTableProps.description: If set, the table has borders between columns

DataTableProps.name: withRowBorders
DataTableProps.description: If set, the table has borders between rows

DataTableProps.name: horizontalSpacing
DataTableProps.description: Horizontal cells spacing, key of `theme.spacing` or any valid CSS value for padding, numbers are converted to rem

DataTableProps.name: verticalSpacing
DataTableProps.description: Vertical cells spacing, key of `theme.spacing` or any valid CSS value for padding, numbers are converted to rem

DataTableProps.name: striped
DataTableProps.description: If set, every odd/even row background changes to `stripedColor`, if set to `true`, then `odd` value will be used

DataTableProps.name: stripedColor
DataTableProps.description: Background color of striped rows, key of `theme.colors` or any valid CSS color

DataTableProps.name: highlightOnHover
DataTableProps.description: If set, table rows background changes to `highlightOnHoverColor` when hovered

DataTableProps.name: highlightOnHoverColor
DataTableProps.description: Background color of table rows when hovered, key of `theme.colors` or any valid CSS color

DataTableProps.name: stickyHeader
DataTableProps.description: If set, `Table.Thead` is sticky

DataTableProps.name: layout
DataTableProps.description: Value of `table-layout` style

DataTableColumn.name: dataIndex
DataTableColumn.description: Unique column ID. Also the row property read when `getValue` is not set.

DataTableColumn.name: type
DataTableColumn.description: Value type for sorting and filtering. Default: inferred, otherwise string.

DataTableColumn.name: getValue
DataTableColumn.description: Value used for sorting, filtering, searching and the default cell. Default: `row[dataIndex]`.

DataTableColumn.name: render
DataTableColumn.description: Custom cell content. Search highlighting applies only to default cells.

DataTableColumn.name: sortable
DataTableColumn.description: Enable sorting.

DataTableColumn.name: defaultSortOrder
DataTableColumn.description: Initial sort order. The first sortable column that sets it wins.

DataTableColumn.name: sortFn
DataTableColumn.description: Ascending comparator; descending reverses it.

DataTableColumn.name: showSortIcon
DataTableColumn.description: Show the sort button in the header. Default: true, or false when `showMenu` is on.

DataTableColumn.name: filterable
DataTableColumn.description: Enable filtering.

DataTableColumn.name: defaultFilterValue
DataTableColumn.description: Initial filter value.

DataTableColumn.name: filterOptions
DataTableColumn.description: Choices for string and boolean filters. Required for string filters in server mode.

DataTableColumn.name: searchableFilter
DataTableColumn.description: Show a search box above string and boolean filter choices.

DataTableColumn.name: filterFn
DataTableColumn.description: Custom predicate for client mode.

DataTableColumn.name: renderFilter
DataTableColumn.description: Custom filter UI.

DataTableColumn.name: showFilterIcon
DataTableColumn.description: Show the filter button in the header. Default: true, or false when `showMenu` is on.

DataTableColumn.name: searchable
DataTableColumn.description:
`true` adds a column search. `false` excludes the column from global search.
Unset: included in global search only.

DataTableColumn.name: defaultSearchValue
DataTableColumn.description: Initial column search text. Requires `searchable: true`.

DataTableColumn.name: showSearchIcon
DataTableColumn.description: Show the search button in the header. Default: true, or false when `showMenu` is on.

DataTableColumn.name: showMenu
DataTableColumn.description: Show the column menu with sort, filter, search, pin and hide actions.

DataTableColumn.name: menuOptions
DataTableColumn.description: Limit and order the menu actions. Default: all.

DataTableColumn.name: pinned
DataTableColumn.description: Initial pinned side.

DataTableColumn.name: pinnable
DataTableColumn.description: Allow pinning from the menu. Default: true.

DataTableColumn.name: hideable
DataTableColumn.description: Allow hiding from the menu and column selector. Default: true.

DataTableColumn.name: stopRowClick
DataTableColumn.description: Keep clicks in this column's cells from triggering `onRowClick` or row expansion.

Pagination.name: currentPage
Pagination.description: Server mode: current page (controlled). Client mode: initial page. Default: 1.

Pagination.name: pageSize
Pagination.description: Server mode: page size (controlled). Client mode: initial page size. Default: 10.

Pagination.name: totalItems
Pagination.description: Server mode: total matching rows (required). Client mode: counted by the table.

Pagination.name: pageSizeOptions
Pagination.description: Page size choices, or false to hide the selector. Default: [10, 20, 50, 100].

SelectionConfig.name: selectedIds
SelectionConfig.description: Controlled selected IDs. Omit to let the table manage selection.

SelectionConfig.name: isSelectable
SelectionConfig.description: Rows that return false cannot be selected.

SelectionConfig.name: showSelectionCount
SelectionConfig.description: Show the selected count in the bulk action bar. Default: true.

SelectionConfig.name: renderBulkActions
SelectionConfig.description: Bulk action bar content. The bar replaces the toolbar while rows are selected.

SelectionSnapshot.name: loadedRows
SelectionSnapshot.description: Selected rows present in the current `rows`. Rows from other server pages are not included.

ExpandableConfig.name: expandedIds
ExpandableConfig.description: Controlled expanded IDs. Omit to let the table manage expansion.

ExpandableConfig.name: allowMultiple
ExpandableConfig.description: Allow several expanded rows at once. Default: false.

ExpandableConfig.name: trigger
ExpandableConfig.description: Expand from the icon or from a row click. Default: 'icon'.
